correctness.rationale: A direct determinant recurrence yields J^N(U_N+igU_(N-1)); each eigenvalue lies strictly in the lower half-plane. For even N the purely imaginary spectrum is exactly the level sets of cosh((N+1)u)/sinh(Nu), whose strictly convex logarithm has one nondegenerate minimum; its double characteristic root is defective by one-dimensional irreducible-Jacobi eigenspaces. For odd N the pole equation is a strictly increasing hyperbolic ratio. The strict even-length threshold ordering and asymptotic (log(4N)+1)/(2N) follow from pointwise N-monotonicity and an exact exponential minimizer equation. The actual packaged standalone checker passed 495 supplementary numerical comparisons. No claim is made off axis.
